final_project_goal: Use CF4 constraints to obtain a statistically valid z=0 local-universe density/velocity posterior, construct an exact q-corrected IC with conditional high-k structure, and forward-validate a zoom IC at an effective observational resolution of <=0.3 cMpc/h.
purpose: Establish, without unsafe dictionary allocation, whether exact geometry grouping can compress the GPFS-free procedural N192 PM basis; if injectivity implies no compression, close that line and select a mathematically controlled alternative without substituting the 16,584 secure CF4 objects for the 7,077,888 PM sources.

science_position.direct_alignment: A feasible Q1-equivalent observation operator is a prerequisite for a statistically valid CF4 z=0 posterior; Q4 does not itself infer that posterior or construct an IC.
science_position.resolution_scope: Q4 release is still the N192, 2 cMpc/h low-k operator. The <=0.3 cMpc/h target remains a separate conditional high-resolution forward-model/resource bundle.
science_position.no_toy_extrapolation: A compression ratio measured on duplicated four-source toys cannot be extrapolated to the PM basis; a ratio near one is a valid NO-GO result for exact geometry grouping.

frozen_source_contract.basis: N_parent=192 cubic particle mesh; positions, LOS directions, displacement scales and state-dependent population mass basis are retained.
frozen_source_contract.group_key: Bitwise position+LOS+displacement-scale key from Q3 exact_geometry_grouping; no tolerance merge or quantisation in this triage.
frozen_source_contract.full_basis_memory_accounting: Include persistent positions, LOS, displacement scales, population masses/mass-basis coefficients, group dictionary/ownership map, and output buffers; chunk-resident bytes alone are insufficient.

procedural_full_pm_geometry.source: Locally generated deterministic canonical N192 lattice with 7,077,888 unique particle positions; no GPFS input or external catalog is read.
procedural_full_pm_geometry.purpose: Lower-bound uniqueness/grouping preflight for the bitwise exact geometry key, not a physical PM evolution or a substitute for a later displaced PM realization.

immutable_metadata.generation_order: lexicographic z-major, then y, then x

procedural_full_pm_geometry.interpretation: A ratio near one on this full-count non-duplicated geometry is a valid terminal NO-GO for exact grouping acceleration; it does not claim that a physical PM catalog has been evolved.

seed_firewall.manifest_hash_scope: Canonical sorted JSON SHA-256 of the complete manifest payload with manifest_sha256 omitted; the emitted digest field is not self-included.
seed_firewall.disjointness_check: Materialize both seed sets and assert no duplicate within or across namespaces before candidate selection; record a hash manifest. Held-out data remain untouched until a candidate and all hyperparameters are frozen.
seed_firewall.selection_rule: Use development data only to select one candidate and freeze its manifest. Held-out is one-shot accept/reject; failure is NO-GO and forbids candidate switching or retuning.

topology_and_gradient_contract.sources_per_fixture: At least three distinct sources plus duplicate and non-duplicate cases; all six populations.
topology_and_gradient_contract.gradient_test: Compare candidate directional JVP/VJP or double-precision finite differences of the scalar Q1 likelihood with latent-field and six population-bias directions. Mass-basis summation alone is not a gradient-equivalence test.
topology_and_gradient_contract.finite_difference: Central float64, relative step=1e-5, absolute step=1e-7; direction vectors and prior metric are inherited from Q3.

resource_contract.performance_target_semantics: 0.1 s is aspiration only. Cold JIT compilation is reported separately. Pass/fail uses warm, synchronized steady-state wall time for all 6912 chunks, including launch and device-to-host synchronization but excluding cold compilation, and requires <=600 s.
resource_contract.memory: Measure peak persistent+temporary host/device memory including full-PM source basis and group dictionary, not just 419.16 MiB chunk projection; both numeric ceilings above apply independently.
resource_contract.operator_change: No operator weakening to meet speed. If exact grouping ratio is approximately one, declare it computationally NO-GO and proceed only to a separately audited adaptive-moment/deposit-then-convolve design.

release_gates: Seed manifest is disjoint and hashed before selection; held-out remains untouched.
Full PM M=7,077,888 group count, timing and persistent memory are measured or exact grouping is declared NO-GO.
Topology and true scalar-likelihood directional gradient gates pass, not merely mass-basis summation.
Measured end-to-end chunked gradient fits the 600 s ceiling; 0.1 s remains aspiration only.
No Q2.1 JAX, held-out release, posterior, KF-EXPAND, IC, PM/HOP/RAMSES or <=0.3 cMpc/h claim is authorized by Q4 alone.
